question: Which of the following mountains of India is famous for tea and coffee production?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nilgiri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nilgiri** mountains are famous for their tea and coffee plantations.
 
• The Nilgiri region has a suitable climate and soil conditions that are ideal for growing tea and coffee.
 
• It is one of the most important tea-producing areas in India.
 
• The plantations in Nilgiri are known for their high-quality tea and coffee, which are exported globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Nilgiri mountains are part of the Western Ghats and are located in the states of Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala.
 
• The region is also known for its rich biodiversity and scenic beauty, making it a popular tourist destination.
 
• Tea plantations in Nilgiri are typically found at altitudes ranging from 1,000 to 2,500 meters above sea level.
 
• In addition to tea and coffee, the region also grows spices like cardamom and pepper.
